# XJTU-SY comparison (revision R1; generated by Experiments/r1_xjtu_stats.py)

Per bearing: mean over each model's seeds (ours 20, baselines 20, re-selected and retrained under plan Amendment 1, E6). Δ = (comparator − reference) / comparator on bearing-averaged CES MAE; positive: reference better. p: exact two-sided sign-flip test over bearings; Holm over the three baselines. Pooled: window-pooled, mean ± SD over seeds. PAVA: offline reference. Descriptive: no Holm-adjusted p can fall below 0.094 (six bearings) or 0.19 (five bearings).
